cohort: The study included 33,794 neonates born between 2009 and 2017 at low-risk and high-risk maternity centers in Brazil.
finding: EOBS incidence was significantly higher in neonates born in high-risk facilities and increased with decreasing gestational age, with Group B Streptococcus being the most frequent causative agent and an overall case fatality rate of 17.8%.
gest_age: All gestational ages (stratified into <32 weeks, 32-36 weeks, and >=37 weeks)
